sources.claim: ITCS 2026 runs Jan 27-30 and AI Festival runs Jan 21-22, both at Bocconi University
AI Week 2026 is May 19-20 at Fiera Milano Rho, Europe's largest AI event with 700+ speakers and 17 stages
AI Week 2026 expected to welcome 25,000+ attendees and 250+ AI exhibitor booths
Milan0Day 2026 cybersecurity conference runs May 21 at Università degli Studi di Milano
ETHMilan 2026 is Italy's largest Web3 conference, May 21-22 at Museo Nazionale della Scienza e della Tecnologia, 2,000+ attendees
Google Cloud AI Live Milano ran May 21 at CityOval, focusing on agentic AI, MarTech, and cloud architecture
ItaliaSec 2026 ran May 26-27 at Milan Marriott, 10th-anniversary edition, speakers from Ferrari, L'Oreal, Barilla
AWS Summit Milano 2026 ran May 28 at Fiera Milano Rho, free to attend, 100+ technical sessions
ECIS 2026 runs June 15-17 at Bocconi University, theme: Reimagining Digital Technology for Business, Management, and Society
AI Conf 2026 is Italy's longest-running native AI conference, 7th edition, June 24 at Talent Garden Calabiana
ServerlessDays Milano 2026 runs October 13, local non-profit community conference on serverless technologies
Codemotion Milan 2026 runs October 28-29 at Superstudio Più, covering AI, cloud architecture, DevOps, and cybersecurity; tickets €179-€499
Codemotion Milan 2026 focuses on mid-to-advanced content; introductory content explicitly rejected
Cloud Day 2026 runs November 18 at Talent Garden Calabiana, 8th edition, vendor-neutral, 3 tracks, 24 talks; Super Early Bird €49 until Sep 12
The Principal Dev and Clean Architecture masterclasses scheduled in Milan for December 3-4 and December 10-11
